changelog: 0.4: Pick which lyrics a song shows (made in Rakki, Spicy Lyrics, its .ttml file or Jellyfin's), song-wide (/Rakki/Lyrics/{id}/Sources, /Rakki/Lyrics/{id}/Source). 0.3: Audio edits (cut, gain, EQ, speed, pitch, fades, reverb) and lyrics made with the tap-to-sync maker, kept by the plugin apart from the music files (/Rakki/Edits, /Rakki/Lyrics). 0.2: Rakki user data (GET/PUT /Rakki/User/Data/{name}), so radio stations follow you to every Rakki. 0.1: Daily Mixes written to playlists (12 AM task, Publish now). Daily Mix preview, skip tracking, one-request playlist check, performance log viewer, and the Spicy Lyrics TTML plugin merged in (lyrics, Spicy Lyrics API, scraper, lyrics search).
description: Server features for the Rakki app: word-by-word lyrics (formerly Spicy Lyrics TTML), lyrics made in Rakki, audio edits, Daily Mixes, skip tracking, playlist sync and performance logs.
name: Rakki
overview: Companion plugin for the Rakki music app.
